# Bid the wrap, the replace, and the extras.

> Price soffit and fascia from eave lineal feet, aluminum wrap versus vinyl replace versus wood replace, 1-story versus 2-story versus 3-story access, and extras — plus the walk-away price a $12 / LF wrap special cannot see.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
